Anya (Product): Heads-up — I'm proposing an "audit-enrichment" approach so every ingestable audit event carries these fields: tenant_id, data_class (sensitive|non-sensitive|pii), retention_tier (ephemeral|cold|standard), evidence_digest, and optional kms_key_ref for BYOK. Goal: make exports + SOC2 evidence deterministic. Need quick alignment on schema, migration/backfill strategy, billing labels, and launch gates.

Matt R (Eng): Sounds good. Can retention_tier be a small enum? Also we should standardize evidence_digest format: `sha256:<hex>` and mention canonicalization rules. How do we treat pre-rollout events?

Devon (Infra): Prefer avoiding full re-ingest. Proposal: add an `enriched_v1` boolean and ship an enrichment worker that annotates older events asynchronously. It writes a sparse index doc so queries and exports see enriched values without reprocessing originals. We'll need a TTL window for backfill jobs.

Samira (Security): For BYOK tenants, evidence_digest should be computed over canonical payload + metadata and include kms_key_ref in the digest salt when present. Add a `legal_hold` flag and `legal_hold_reference` for overrides. Exports must include attestation metadata (kms grant id, timestamp, signer).

Anya (Product): Draft launch gates: 1) ingest validates schema v1 and rejects malformed events; 2) Console shows per-tenant retention tier counts and storage projection; 3) Export path can produce an encrypted evidence bundle for BYOK tenants with attestation; 4) SOC2 runbook and proof checklist sign-off by Security.

Matt R (Eng): Sample event payload proposal:
```json
{"event_ts":"2024-05-06T15:30:00Z","tenant_id":"t_acme","event_type":"chat.completion","evidence_digest":"sha256:9b4e...","retention_tier":"standard","data_class":"sensitive","kms_key_ref":"projects/acct/kr/keys/abc123","billing_label":"t_acme"}
```

Devon (Infra): For billing, use `billing_label` and `retention_tier` -> map to $/GB/mo for forecasting. Rough infra delta: +2-5% storage overhead for extra index fields, small CPU for enrichment, negligible network. I'll add numbers to RFC.

Samira (Security): Also require export-time ephemeral decryption grants instead of storing keys. Store only `kms_key_ref` and `grant_audit_id` for traceability. Add `attestation_log_id` field written to audit trail.

Anya (Product): Owners: Product (Anya) — acceptance criteria and stakeholder comms; Eng (Matt R) — schema + validation + API; Infra (Devon) — enrichment pipeline + backfill; Security (Samira) — SOC2 runbook + attestation flow + threat model. Ops-bot: create RFC stub, please. :pray:

ops-bot: RFC stub created: https://docs.internal/rfcs/audit-enrichment-cost-playbook (created by Anya) :white_check_mark:

Matt R (Eng): Quick question — how strict should ingestion be day 1? Hard reject unknown fields or lenient with warnings? Hard rejects prevent noisy downstream handling but slow adoption.

Samira (Security): For compliance surfaces, prefer strict validation for required fields (`tenant_id`, `evidence_digest`, `retention_tier`). Non-essential fields can be optional. Log validation failures to a quarantine queue.

Devon (Infra): Agree. We'll implement a quarantine path and metrics for rejections. Backfill worker will target quarantined + pre-rollout events. Backfill schedule: rolling over 48-72h for initial rollout, adjustable.

Anya (Product): Acceptance tests: export-by-tenant works for both hosted + BYOK tenants, evidence_digest matches export bundle, console retention view matches storage backend. SOC2 checklist: 10 items (ingest validation, attestation, retention proof, legal hold override, export audit trail, runbook).

Matt R (Eng): I'll add unit tests for canonicalization, enricher e2e test, and an API contract.

Samira (Security): We'll provide threat-model review and the attestation schema. Also want a fallback policy: if BYOK attestation fails at export, export should fail closed and surface a legal notification.

Anya (Product): Timeline: RFC this week, eng spikes next week, minimal rollout in 4 sprints. Need rough cost model for sales: Devon pls include $/GB/mo mapping per retention_tier in RFC.

Devon (Infra): Will do. Rough mapping in RFC and refined after tests.

Anya (Product): Thanks team — I'll post a first RFC draft by EOD Fri and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
